title: Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets
summary: Given an integer array and an integer k, determine if the array can be divided into k non-empty subsets with equal sums.
statement: Given an integer array and an integer k, determine if the array can be divided into k non-empty subsets with equal sums.
constraints: Use every value exactly once to form k nonempty subsets with equal sums.
reference_solution:
def can_partition_k_subsets(nums, k):
    total=sum(nums)
    if total%k:return False
    target=total//k;nums=sorted(nums,reverse=True);bins=[0]*k
    def search(index):
        if index==len(nums):return True
        value=nums[index]
        for bucket in range(k):
            if bins[bucket]+value>target:continue
            bins[bucket]+=value
            if search(index+1):return True
            bins[bucket]-=value
            if bins[bucket]==0:break
        return False
    return nums[0]<=target and search(0)
hints: Once the target sum is fixed, the task is a symmetric bucket assignment.
Place large values first and backtrack while skipping equivalent bucket sums.
Try each value in a fitting bucket; after an empty-bucket failure, stop trying other empty buckets.
Sorting exposes impossibility early, and equal-load buckets are interchangeable, making symmetry pruning sound.
